messages.text: The build now creates the correct first-priority Windows entrypoint, and 22 of 23 cases are semantically producing the expected content; the remaining broad byte mismatches come from Python’s Windows text layer converting UTF-8 box characters and LF to the active code page/CRLF. I’m moving final stdout/stderr writes to explicit UTF-8 bytes and fixing flag tokenization, which preserves Nushell’s byte contract independently of the launcher or console encoding.
